construction: one long cylinder per strut line (SC lines pass through all nodes); x-lines offset by 0.01 mm in y,z to avoid a triple point; fused with a balanced tree; intersected with the box [0,L]^3
notes: Exact B-Rep is within 0.1% of the marching-cubes reference (664).
Field SC at 256 is about 1.2% high; the SDF path converges slowly with resolution.
Naive per-cell struts fail in the kernel: coaxial end-to-end contact (SM_ERR) and sphere-tangent contact. Long per-line cylinders avoid both.
